#Setting Up the Data
``` {r reading and cleaning data - raw data}
neg_raw_data <- read_csv("tce_acute_exposure_neg_plasma_08222025_TF.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(Compound, Filename, Area) %>%
  mutate(Area = as.numeric(Area)) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace_na(.x, 0)))

#Fixing injection errors: after I ran the samples, I realized a few samples were put into some positions erroneously and that there was an additional real plasma sample that wasn't actually there.
neg_raw_data_cleaned <- neg_raw_data %>%
mutate(
    filename = filename %>%
      #Using placeholders so nothing gets overwritten
      str_replace("10_nm_(pre|post)", "TEMP10um_\\1") %>%
      str_replace("10_um_(pre|post)", "TEMP10nm_\\1") %>%
      str_replace("100_nm_(pre|post)", "TEMP100um_\\1") %>%
      str_replace("100_um_(pre|post)", "TEMP100nm_\\1") %>%
      #Converting placeholders back to proper labels
      str_replace("TEMP10um", "10_um") %>%
      str_replace("TEMP10nm", "10_nm") %>%
      str_replace("TEMP100um", "100_um") %>%
      str_replace("TEMP100nm", "100_nm")
  )

pos_raw_data <- read_csv("tce_acute_exposure_plasma_pos_09032025_TF.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(Compound, Filename, Area) %>%
  mutate(Area = as.numeric(Area))%>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace_na(.x, 0)))

#Fixing injection error
pos_raw_data_cleaned <- pos_raw_data %>%
mutate(
    filename = filename %>%
      str_replace("10_nm_(pre|post)", "TEMP10um_\\1") %>%
      str_replace("10_um_(pre|post)", "TEMP10nm_\\1") %>%
      str_replace("100_nm_(pre|post)", "TEMP100um_\\1") %>%
      str_replace("100_um_(pre|post)", "TEMP100nm_\\1") %>%
      str_replace("TEMP10um", "10_um") %>%
      str_replace("TEMP10nm", "10_nm") %>%
      str_replace("TEMP100um", "100_um") %>%
      str_replace("TEMP100nm", "100_nm")
  ) %>%
  filter(filename != "pl_pos_41")
```

``` {r reshaping blanks data}
#Function to clean blanks in long format
clean_blanks_long <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      blank_type = case_when(
        str_detect(filename, "matrix_blank") ~ "matrix",
        str_detect(filename, "blank_[1-3]$") ~ "calibration",  #first 3 negative blanks
        str_detect(filename, "blank") ~ "solvent_blank",
        str_detect(filename, "pl_neg_1[7-9]$|pl_neg_20$|pl_neg_38$|pl_neg_40$") ~ "pl_control_blank",
        TRUE ~ "other"
      ),
      replicate = str_extract(filename, "\\d+$")
    ) %>%
    arrange(compound, blank_type, replicate)
}

clean_blanks_long2 <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      blank_type = case_when(
        str_detect(filename, "matrix_blank") ~ "matrix",
        str_detect(filename, "blank_[1-3]$") ~ "calibration",  #first 3 negative blanks
        str_detect(filename, "blank") ~ "solvent_blank",
        str_detect(filename, "pl_pos_1[7-9]$|pl_pos_20$|pl_pos_38$|pl_pos_40$") ~ "pl_control_blank",
        TRUE ~ "other"
      ),
      replicate = str_extract(filename, "\\d+$")
    ) %>%
    arrange(compound, blank_type, replicate)
}

#Compute mean and SD per compound × blank_type
compute_blank_stats <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(compound, blank_type) %>%
    summarise(
      blank_mean = mean(area, na.rm = TRUE),
      blank_sd   = sd(area, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

#Keep all individual replicate values (long format)
neg_blanks_long <- clean_blanks_long(neg_raw_data_cleaned) %>%
  filter(!blank_type == "other")

pos_blanks_long <- clean_blanks_long2(pos_raw_data_cleaned) %>%
  filter(!blank_type == "other")

#Compute mean & SD
neg_blanks_stats <- compute_blank_stats(neg_blanks_long)
pos_blanks_stats <- compute_blank_stats(pos_blanks_long)

#Optional: pivot to wide format for Excel export (mean and SD only)
neg_blanks_means <- neg_blanks_stats %>%
  dplyr::select(compound, blank_type, blank_mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = blank_type, values_from = blank_mean, names_glue = "{blank_type}_mean")

pos_blanks_means <- pos_blanks_stats %>%
  dplyr::select(compound, blank_type, blank_mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = blank_type, values_from = blank_mean, names_glue = "{blank_type}_mean")

#Export everything in long + wide format
library(writexl)
write_xlsx(
  list(
    neg_blanks_long  = neg_blanks_long,
    pos_blanks_long  = pos_blanks_long,
    neg_blanks_stats = neg_blanks_stats,
    pos_blanks_stats = pos_blanks_stats,
    neg_blanks_means = neg_blanks_means,
    pos_blanks_means = pos_blanks_means
  ),
  "all_blanks_data_plasma_final.xlsx"
)

```

``` {r blank subtracting the data}
#don't blank subtract the standards
compound_to_exclude <- c("Rafoxanide", "[13C6]-D-glucose", "[13C6]-D-glucose 2", "[13C5]-L-glutamic acid", "[3,3-13C2]-cystine")

neg_raw_corrected <- neg_raw_data_cleaned %>%
  left_join(neg_blanks_means, by = "compound") %>%
  mutate(
    area_corrected = case_when(
      compound %in% compound_to_exclude ~ area,                  #skip subtraction
      str_detect(filename, "std") ~ area - calibration_mean,   
      str_detect(filename, "post|pre") ~ area - matrix_mean,
      TRUE ~ area - pl_control_blank_mean                                  #subtract otherwise
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-ends_with("_mean"))


compound_to_exclude <- c("[13C5]-L-glutamic acid", "[3,3-13C2]-cystine", "[trimethyl-13C3]-caffeine", "[U-13C5, U-15N2]-L-glutamine", "[15N]-indole", "Spiroxamine")

pos_raw_corrected <- pos_raw_data_cleaned %>%
  left_join(neg_blanks_means, by = "compound") %>%
  mutate(
    area_corrected = case_when(
      compound %in% compound_to_exclude ~ area,                  #skip subtraction
      str_detect(filename, "std") ~ area - calibration_mean,   
      str_detect(filename, "post|pre") ~ area - matrix_mean,
      TRUE ~ area - pl_control_blank_mean                                  #subtract otherwise
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-ends_with("_mean"))
```

``` {r normalizing by ISTD}
rafox_by_file <- neg_raw_corrected %>%
  filter(compound == "Rafoxanide") %>%
  dplyr::select(filename, rafox_area = area_corrected)

#Reference IS concentration used for calibration
IS_ref_ppb <- 150

#Define actual IS concentration for each filename
correction_factors_neg <- tibble::tibble(
  filename = c("100_um_std_neg", "10_um_std_neg", "1_um_std_neg", "100_nm_std_neg", "10_nm_std_neg"),
  is_sample_ppb = c(165.003, 165.603, 166.5633, 166.6593, 166.6689)
)

neg_istd_normalized_data <- neg_raw_corrected %>%
  left_join(rafox_by_file, by = "filename") %>%
  left_join(correction_factors_neg, by = "filename") %>%
  mutate(
    #Compute correction factor (ref / sample)
    is_corr_factor = ifelse(!is.na(is_sample_ppb), IS_ref_ppb / is_sample_ppb, 1),
    #Apply correction to normalized area
    area_norm = (area_corrected / rafox_area) * is_corr_factor
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-rafox_area, -is_sample_ppb, -is_corr_factor)

spirox_by_file <- pos_raw_corrected %>%
  filter(compound == "Spiroxamine") %>%
  dplyr::select(filename, spirox_area = area_corrected)

#Define actual IS concentration for each filename
correction_factors_pos <- tibble::tibble(
  filename = c("100_um_std_pos", "10_um_std_pos", "1_um_std_pos", "100_nm_std_pos", "10_nm_std_pos"),
  is_sample_ppb = c(165.003, 165.603, 166.5633, 166.6593, 166.6689)
)

pos_istd_normalized_data <- pos_raw_corrected %>%
  left_join(spirox_by_file, by = "filename") %>%
  left_join(correction_factors_pos, by = "filename") %>%
  mutate(
    #Compute correction factor (ref / sample)
    is_corr_factor = ifelse(!is.na(is_sample_ppb), IS_ref_ppb / is_sample_ppb, 1),
    #Apply correction to normalized area
    area_norm = (area_corrected / spirox_area) * is_corr_factor
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-spirox_area, -is_sample_ppb, -is_corr_factor)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    neg_istd_normalized_data = neg_istd_normalized_data,
    pos_istd_normalized_data = pos_istd_normalized_data
  ),
  "all_istd_normalized_data_final.xlsx"
)
```

``` {r reshaping the data - using function - post spike data}
clean_post_spike <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    #Keep only "post" samples
    filter(str_detect(filename, "post")) %>%
    #Extract dose, tissue, and replicate
    mutate(
      dose = str_extract(filename, "10_nm|100_nm|1_um|10_um|100_um"),
      replicate = str_extract(filename, "\\d+$"),
      #Use area_norm if exists, otherwise area_corrected
      intensity = if ("area_norm" %in% names(.)) area_norm else area
    ) %>%
    #Pivot so all replicates for a compound/dose/tissue are on one row
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(compound, dose),   #row identifier
      names_from = replicate,
      values_from = intensity,
      names_prefix = "rep"
    ) %>%
    #Order the doses
    mutate(
      dose = factor(dose, levels = c("10_nm", "100_nm", "1_um", "10_um", "100_um"))
    ) %>%
    arrange(compound, dose)
}

neg_istd_post_spike_data_wide <- clean_post_spike(neg_istd_normalized_data)

neg_post_spike_data_wide <- clean_post_spike(neg_raw_data_cleaned)

pos_istd_post_spike_data_wide <- clean_post_spike(pos_istd_normalized_data)

pos_post_spike_data_wide <- clean_post_spike(pos_raw_data_cleaned)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    neg_istd_post_spike_data_wide = neg_istd_post_spike_data_wide,
    neg_post_spike_data_wide = neg_post_spike_data_wide,
    pos_istd_post_spike_data_wide = pos_istd_post_spike_data_wide,
    pos_post_spike_data_wide = pos_post_spike_data_wide
  ),
  "all_post_spike_data_final.xlsx"
)
```

``` {r extracting data - actual samples}
  filter(str_starts(filename, "pl")) %>%

  dplyr::select(compound, filename, area_norm)

  filter(str_starts(filename, "pl")) %>%
```

``` {r reshaping the data - using function - actual samples data}
clean_samples <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      subj_id = as.integer(str_extract(filename, "\\d+")),
      #assign treatment based on subject ID
      treatment = case_when(
        subj_id %in% 1:5  ~ "4 hr",
        subj_id %in% 6:10 ~ "1 hr",
        subj_id %in% 11:15 ~ "2 hr",
        subj_id %in% 16:20 ~ "No Exposure",
        subj_id %in% 21:25 ~ "0 hr",
        subj_id %in% 26:31 ~ "24 hr",
        subj_id %in% 32:37 ~ "8 hr",
        TRUE ~ "No Exposure"   #default fallback
      ),
      replicate = row_number() %>% as.character()  #temporary replicate assignment
    ) %>%
    group_by(compound, treatment) %>%
    mutate(replicate = paste0("rep", row_number())) %>%  #true replicate numbering
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(compound, treatment, replicate, area_norm) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = replicate,
      values_from = area_norm,
      values_fn = list(area_norm = mean),   #or = list(area_norm = identity) if you want ALL values kept
      values_fill = NA
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      treatment = factor(treatment,
                         levels = c("No Exposure", "0 hr", "1 hr", "2 hr", "4 hr", "8 hr", "24 hr"))
    ) %>%
    arrange(compound, treatment)
}

neg_istd_data_samples_wide <- clean_samples(neg_istd_data_samples)
pos_istd_data_samples_wide  <- clean_samples(pos_istd_data_samples)

clean_samples2 <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      subj_id = as.integer(str_extract(filename, "\\d+")),
      #assign treatment based on subject ID
      treatment = case_when(
        subj_id %in% 1:5  ~ "4 hr",
        subj_id %in% 6:10 ~ "1 hr",
        subj_id %in% 11:15 ~ "2 hr",
        subj_id %in% 16:20 ~ "No Exposure",
        subj_id %in% 21:25 ~ "0 hr",
        subj_id %in% 26:31 ~ "24 hr",
        subj_id %in% 32:37 ~ "8 hr",
        subj_id %in% 38:41 ~ "No Exposure",
        TRUE ~ "No Exposure"   #default fallback
      ),
      replicate = row_number() %>% as.character()  #temporary replicate assignment
    ) %>%
    group_by(compound, treatment) %>%
    mutate(replicate = paste0("rep", row_number())) %>%  #true replicate numbering
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(compound, treatment, replicate, area) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = replicate,
      values_from = area,
      values_fn = list(area = mean),   #or = list(area_norm = identity) if you want ALL values kept
      values_fill = NA
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      treatment = factor(treatment,
                         levels = c("No Exposure", "0 hr", "1 hr", "2 hr", "4 hr", "8 hr", "24 hr"))
    ) %>%
    arrange(compound, treatment)
}

neg_data_samples_wide <- clean_samples2(neg_data_samples)
pos_data_samples_wide  <- clean_samples2(pos_data_samples)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    neg_istd_data_samples_wide = neg_istd_data_samples_wide,
    pos_istd_data_samples_wide = pos_istd_data_samples_wide,
    neg_data_samples_wide = neg_data_samples_wide,
    pos_data_samples_wide = pos_data_samples_wide
  ),
  "all_samples_data.xlsx"
)
```

#Fitting sample data to Matrix Matched Calibration Curve - OLS Model
``` {r matrix matched calibration curve models}
dose_edited <- c("10_nm" = 0.01, "100_nm" = 0.1, "1_um" = 1, "10_um" = 10, "100_um" = 100)

neg_istd_post_spike_data_wide <- neg_istd_post_spike_data_wide %>%
  mutate(dose_num = recode(dose, !!!dose_edited)) %>%
  filter(!compound %in% c("Rafoxanide", "[13C6]-D-glucose", "[13C6]-D-glucose 2", 
                          "[13C5]-L-glutamic acid", "[3,3-13C2]-cystine"))

neg_clean <- neg_istd_post_spike_data_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("rep"),
    names_to = "rep",
    values_to = "area"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(area), !is.infinite(area)) %>%
  group_by(compound, dose_num) %>%
  mutate(bad = area <= 0) %>%
  summarise(
    n_bad = sum(bad),
    area = list(area),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_bad < 2) %>%                      #keep good concentrations
  unnest(area) %>%                           #return to long format
  select(compound, dose_num, area)

mm_neg_models <- neg_clean %>%
  group_by(compound) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    df <- .x

    #need at least 2 concentration levels
    if (n_distinct(df$dose_num) < 2) {
      return(tibble(
        compound = unique(df$compound),
        slope = NA_real_,
        intercept = 0,
        r2 = NA_real_,
        rmse = NA_real_,
        model = list(NULL)
      ))
    }

    model <- lm(area ~ 0 + dose_num, data = df)
    preds <- predict(model, newdata = df)
    rmse_val <- sqrt(mean((preds - df$area)^2))

    tibble(
      compound = unique(df$compound),
      tissue = unique(df$tissue),
      slope = coef(model)[["dose_num"]],
      intercept = 0,
      r2 = summary(model)$r.squared,
      rmse = rmse_val,
      model = list(model)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

#Build a residuals data frame for all models
residuals_all <- mm_neg_models %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(model, is.null)) %>%                  #only keep models that exist
  mutate(resid_df = map(model, ~ {
    tibble(
      dose_num  = .x$model$dose_num,                   #grab dose values
      residuals = residuals(.x)
    )
  })) %>%
  unnest(resid_df) %>%
  filter(!compound %in% c("DCVC", "DCVG", "NAcDCVC", "Unknown1", "Unknown2"))

#Q-Q plot faceted by compound
ggplot(residuals_all, aes(sample = residuals)) +
  stat_qq() +
  stat_qq_line(color = "red") +
  facet_wrap( ~ compound) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
  ) +
  labs(title = "Q-Q plots of matrix-matched calibration residuals - Neg Mode - Plasma - OLS",
       x = "Theoretical Quantiles",
       y = "Sample Quantiles")

pos_istd_post_spike_data_wide <- pos_istd_post_spike_data_wide %>%
  mutate(dose_num = recode(dose, !!!dose_edited)) %>%
  filter(!compound %in% c("Spiroxamine", "U-13C5, U-15N2]-L-glutamine", "[13C5]-L-glutamic acid", "[15N]-indole", "[3,3-13C2]-cystine", "[trimethyl-13C3]-caffeine"))

pos_clean <- pos_istd_post_spike_data_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("rep"),
    names_to = "rep",
    values_to = "area"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(area), !is.infinite(area)) %>%
  group_by(compound, dose_num) %>%
  mutate(bad = area <= 0) %>%
  summarise(
    n_bad = sum(bad),
    area = list(area),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_bad < 2) %>%                      #keep good concentrations
  unnest(area) %>%                           #return to long format
  select(compound, dose_num, area)

pos_removed <- pos_istd_post_spike_data_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("rep"), names_to = "rep", values_to = "area") %>%
  filter(!is.na(area), !is.infinite(area)) %>%
  group_by(compound, dose_num) %>%
  mutate(bad = area <= 0) %>%
  summarise(n_bad = sum(bad), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_bad >= 2)

mm_pos_models <- pos_clean %>%
  group_by(compound) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    df <- .x

    #need at least 2 concentration levels
    if (n_distinct(df$dose_num) < 2) {
      return(tibble(
        compound = unique(df$compound),
        slope = NA_real_,
        intercept = 0,
        r2 = NA_real_,
        rmse = NA_real_,
        model = list(NULL)
      ))
    }

    model <- lm(area ~ 0 + dose_num, data = df)
    preds <- predict(model, newdata = df)
    rmse_val <- sqrt(mean((preds - df$area)^2))

    tibble(
      compound = unique(df$compound),
      slope = coef(model)[["dose_num"]],
      intercept = 0,
      r2 = summary(model)$r.squared,
      rmse = rmse_val,
      model = list(model)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

#Build a residuals data frame for all models
residuals_all <- mm_pos_models %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(model, is.null)) %>%                  #only keep models that exist
  mutate(resid_df = map(model, ~ {
    tibble(
      dose_num  = .x$model$dose_num,                   #grab dose values
      residuals = residuals(.x)
    )
  })) %>%
  unnest(resid_df)

#Q-Q plot faceted by compound
ggplot(residuals_all, aes(sample = residuals)) +
  stat_qq() +
  stat_qq_line(color = "red") +
  facet_wrap(~ compound) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
  ) +
  labs(title = "Q-Q plots of matrix-matched calibration residuals - Pos Mode - Plasma - OLS",
       x = "Theoretical Quantiles",
       y = "Sample Quantiles")
```

``` {r predicting sample concentrations}
#Data in long format
neg_istd_data_samples_long <- neg_istd_data_samples_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("rep"),
    names_to = "rep",
    values_to = "area_corrected"
  )

pos_istd_data_samples_long <- pos_istd_data_samples_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("rep"),
    names_to = "rep",
    values_to = "area_corrected"
  )

#Predict sample concentrations in linear scale
neg_istd_samples_mm_joined <- neg_istd_data_samples_long %>%
  left_join(mm_neg_models, by = c("compound"))

neg_istd_samples_pred <- neg_istd_samples_mm_joined %>%
  mutate(
    pred_conc = map2_dbl(area_corrected, model, ~ {
      if (is.null(.y)) return(NA_real_)
      coef(.y)[["dose_num"]] -> slope
      .x / slope
    })) %>%
  dplyr::select(-model)

pos_istd_samples_mm_joined <- pos_istd_data_samples_long %>%
  left_join(mm_neg_models, by = c("compound"))

pos_istd_samples_pred <- pos_istd_samples_mm_joined %>%
  mutate(
    pred_conc = map2_dbl(area_corrected, model, ~ {
      if (is.null(.y)) return(NA_real_)
      coef(.y)[["dose_num"]] -> slope
      .x / slope
    })) %>%
  dplyr::select(-model)
```

``` {r calibration summary}
n_points_info <- neg_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(area), !is.infinite(area)) %>%
  group_by(compound) %>%
  summarise(n_points = n_distinct(dose_num), .groups = "drop")

mm_neg_models <- mm_neg_models %>%
  left_join(n_points_info, by = c("compound"))

n_points_info <- pos_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(area), !is.infinite(area)) %>%
  group_by(compound) %>%
  summarise(n_points = n_distinct(dose_num), .groups = "drop")

mm_pos_models <- mm_pos_models %>%
  left_join(n_points_info, by = c("compound"))

calibration_summary <- bind_rows(
  mm_neg_models %>% mutate(mode = "Negative"),
  mm_pos_models %>% mutate(mode = "Positive")
) %>%
  select(mode, compound, slope, r2, rmse, n_points) %>%
  mutate(
    quality_flag = case_when(
      is.na(r2) ~ "No model",
      r2 < 0.8 ~ "Poor fit",
      r2 >= 0.8 & r2 < 0.95 ~ "Acceptable",
      r2 >= 0.95 ~ "Good fit"
    )) %>%
   mutate(
    slope = round(slope, 3),
    r2 = round(r2, 3),
    rmse = round(rmse, 3))

#View top of table
head(calibration_summary)
```

``` {r wide format for Prism}
neg_istd_samples_pred_wide <- neg_istd_samples_pred %>%
  dplyr::select(compound, treatment, rep, pred_conc) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = rep,
    values_from = pred_conc,
    names_prefix = "rep"
  ) %>%
  arrange(compound, treatment)

summary_table_neg <- neg_istd_samples_pred_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("rep"), 
    names_to = "replicate", 
    values_to = "concentration_uM",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) %>%
  group_by(compound, treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    Mean = mean(concentration_uM, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(concentration_uM, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(concentration_uM, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min = min(concentration_uM, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max = max(concentration_uM, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(compound, treatment) %>%
  mutate(
    Mean_SD = paste0(round(Mean,3), " ± ", round(SD,3)),
    Median = round(Median, 3),  
    Range = paste0(round(Min,3), " - ", round(Max,3))  #combine min/max into one column
  ) %>%
  select(compound, treatment, n, Mean_SD, Median, Range)

pos_istd_samples_pred_wide <- pos_istd_samples_pred %>%
  dplyr::select(compound, treatment, rep, pred_conc) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = rep,
    values_from = pred_conc,
    names_prefix = "rep"
  ) %>%
  arrange(compound, treatment)

summary_table_pos <- pos_istd_samples_pred_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("rep"), 
    names_to = "replicate", 
    values_to = "concentration_uM",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) %>%
  group_by(compound, treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    Mean = mean(concentration_uM, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(concentration_uM, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(concentration_uM, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min = min(concentration_uM, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max = max(concentration_uM, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(compound, treatment) %>%
  mutate(
    Mean_SD = paste0(round(Mean,3), " ± ", round(SD,3)),
    Median = round(Median, 3),  
    Range = paste0(round(Min,3), " - ", round(Max,3))  #combine min/max into one column
  ) %>%
  select(compound, treatment, n, Mean_SD, Median, Range)

write_xlsx(
    list(summary_table_neg = summary_table_neg,
```
